409	+/// from the Home/Chat "+" control (`placeholder_screens.dart`). Only
410	+/// Texto is functional this story (Boundaries) — Áudio/Foto each render
411	+/// their own idle, non-interactive placeholder (Stories 3.2/3.3).
412	+class InsertionModal extends StatelessWidget {
413	+  const InsertionModal({required this.cubit, super.key});
414	+
415	+  final TextEntryCubit cubit;
416	+
417	+  /// Presents the modal exactly as the Boundaries dictate:
418	+  /// `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor:
419	+  /// colorScrimHeavy)`, `radiusLg` top corners + `elevation2` (drawn by
420	+  /// this widget's own `Container`, not Material's `elevation` double —
421	+  /// same convention `ConfirmationDialog`'s card already uses), and a
422	+  /// `durationSheetUp` entrance that collapses to zero under Reduce
423	+  /// Motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations`).
424	+  ///
425	+  /// [cubit] is a fresh, `get_it`-factory-scoped instance — one per "+"
426	+  /// tap (Boundaries: "Modal open resets"), closed here once the sheet is
427	+  /// gone, regardless of how it closed (Salvar success, "x", swipe-down,
428	+  /// or barrier dismiss) — the caller never has to remember to do this
429	+  /// itself.
430	+  static Future<void> show(
431	+    BuildContext context, {
432	+    required TextEntryCubit cubit,
433	+  }) async {
434	+    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
435	+    final controller =
436	+        BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
437	+          ..duration = reduceMotion
438	+              ? Duration.zero
439	+              : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
440	+          // Boundaries only names the entrance, but Reduce Motion should
441	+          // collapse the exit the same way — otherwise dismissing the
442	+          // sheet would still animate for anyone who asked for no motion.
443	+          ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
444	+    try {
445	+      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
446	+        context: context,
447	+        isScrollControlled: true,
448	+        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
449	+        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
450	+        elevation: 0,
451	+        transitionAnimationController: controller,
452	+        builder: (_) => InsertionModal(cubit: cubit),
453	+      );
454	+    } finally {
455	+      // `showModalBottomSheet`'s own Future completes as soon as the
456	+      // route is popped — *before* the exit (`reverse()`) animation the
457	+      // framework drives on this same controller actually finishes.
458	+      // Disposing immediately would cancel that animation's ticker
459	+      // mid-flight, permanently freezing the sheet on screen (its
460	+      // `AnimatedBuilder` keeps rendering the controller's last value,
461	+      // and the route itself never reaches `AnimationStatus.dismissed`
462	+      // to be removed from the `Overlay`). Documented behavior
463	+      // (`BottomSheet.transitionAnimationController`'s own doc: "the
464	+      // caller is responsible for disposing it when the controller is
465	+      // no longer needed") — waiting for `dismissed` first is that
466	+      // "no longer needed" point.
467	+      if (!controller.isDismissed) {
468	+        final animationDone = Completer<void>();
469	+        void onStatusChange(AnimationStatus status) {
470	+          if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
471	+            animationDone.complete();
472	+          }
473	+        }
474	+
475	+        controller.addStatusListener(onStatusChange);
476	+        await animationDone.future;
477	+        controller.removeStatusListener(onStatusChange);

@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+---
+title: 'Story 3.1: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell'
+type: 'feature'
+created: '2026-11-04'
+status: 'in-review'
+review_loop_iteration: 0
+context: []
+baseline_commit: '12cdeaa93f773d1e68061196f04bb89627cdc849'
+---
+
+<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
+
+## Intent
+
+**Problem:** There is no way to capture a journal Entry yet — `features/entries/` and `features/capture/` are empty scaffolds, and the Home/Chat screen has no "+" entry point.
+
+**Approach:** Stand up `features/entries/` (Entry entity, `EntriesRepository.create` port, entries Hive box) and `features/capture/` (Insertion Modal bottom sheet with 3 tabs), and add a minimal "+" control to the Home/Chat placeholder that opens it. Only the Texto tab is functional this story.
+
+## Boundaries & Constraints
+
+**Always:**
+- `features/entries/domain` owns `Entry` (plain class, no freezed — mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`), `EntrySource` enum (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`), and `EntriesRepository` (abstract, one method: `create`). `features/capture/` imports only `entries/domain`, never `entries/data` or `entries/presentation` (RNF06).
+- `EntriesRepository.create` → `Either<Failure, Entry>`, posts to `entries-create` via the shared `ApiClient.post`, source=`manual` for this story. On success, write the entry through to the `entries` Hive box (`Box<Map>`, keyed by id) — first use of `hive_ce` in the app.
+- Insertion Modal: `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy)`, `radiusLg` top corners, `elevation2`, new `DesignTokens.durationSheetUp` (200ms) entrance, skipped under Reduce Motion. 3 equal-width tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto); only the active tab fills `colorPrimary`. Close "x" always present. Opens on Texto, all 3 tabs idle/empty.
+- Texto tab: text field + Salvar. Salvar fires `POST /entries`; success closes the modal; failure (including offline, via the existing `Failure.networkOffline`) shows `Failure.message` inline and re-enables Salvar — no auto-retry, reuse `Failure.fromCode`/`retryable` as-is.
+- "+" control on `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`: always tappable, opens the modal. No proactive offline detection or banner in this story (deferred — see Spec Change Log / `deferred-work.md`); an offline save attempt surfaces the same way any other failed save does.
+- 44pt tap targets, Dynamic Type with no truncation, announced labels for every state change (no color-only signal).
+
+**Ask First:** none identified.
+
+**Never:**
+- Implement Áudio/Foto tab capture logic (render idle/empty only — Stories 3.2/3.3).
+- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story only needs the trivial case: the text tab never calls `create` except on explicit Salvar.
+- Build the full chat composer (text field + send icon) — RF04's scope. Add only the "+" tap target.
+- Add a connectivity service, offline banner, or any proactive offline-disabling of "+" — deferred (see `deferred-work.md`); no existing pattern to reuse, and the prototype doesn't represent this state.
+- Add `GET /entries`, listing, search, or any `Entry` fields beyond `{id, content, source, chatMessageId, occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt}` (tags/piiStatus/embeddingStatus belong to later epics).
+- Use the shared `Resource<T>` type for capture's state — capture defines its own sealed state class.
+
+## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
+
+| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
+| Happy path save | Texto tab, non-empty text, tap Salvar | `POST /entries` (`source: manual`) fires; on success modal closes, returns to Home | N/A |
+| Modal open resets | "+" tapped | Opens on Texto; all 3 tabs idle/empty regardless of prior session | N/A |
+| Save fails (incl. offline) | Salvar tapped, backend call returns a mapped error code (e.g. `NETWORK_OFFLINE`) | Inline message from `Failure.message`; Salvar re-enabled; modal stays open | `Failure.fromCode`, no auto-retry |
+| Cancel before save | "x" tapped or user leaves with unsaved text | Modal closes/resets; no `POST /entries` fires | N/A |
+
+</frozen-after-approval>
+
+## Code Map
+
+- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:76-130` (`HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`) — add the "+" entry point here; body is currently a pure placeholder (RF04 not built), no composer exists.
+- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:85` (`colorScrimHeavy`, already reserved for "a later story's insertion modal"), `:199` (`radiusLg`), `:218` (`elevation2`) — reuse as-is; add `durationSheetUp` near these, no `Duration`/motion token exists yet.
+- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:67-83` (`Failure.fromCode`) — reuse unchanged; already generic, no new mapping needed.
+- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart:52-62` (`post`) — call via the new `EntriesRemoteDataSource`.
+- `lib/core/network/header_interceptor.dart:20-24` (`anonKeyOnlyFunctions`) — `entries-create` is not in that set, so it auto-gets the user bearer token; no changes needed.
+- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:26-84` (`setupCoreDependencies`) — add `Hive.initFlutter()` + `registerEntriesFeature()` + `registerCaptureFeature()`, after the existing `registerAccountFeature()` call.
+- `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart`, `account_remote_data_source.dart`, `account_settings_dto.dart`, `account_settings_repository_impl.dart`, `account_settings_cubit.dart` — structural patterns to mirror (DI registration, `ApiClient` datasource, `@JsonSerializable` DTO, repository impl, cubit calling repository directly — no use-case layer exists in this codebase).
+- `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` — plain-class entity pattern (no freezed) to mirror for `Entry`.
+- `lib/features/entries/{data,domain,presentation}/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/capture/{data,domain,presentation}/.gitkeep` — empty scaffolds to fill.
+- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:327-449` — `entries-create` request/response schema.
+- `pubspec.yaml:42-43` — `hive_ce`/`hive_ce_flutter` already a dependency, unused until now.
+- `test/features/account/**` — test directory layout to mirror under `test/features/entries/` and `test/features/capture/`.
+
+## Tasks & Acceptance
+
+**Execution:**
+- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add `durationSheetUp = Duration(milliseconds: 200)` -- no entrance-animation token exists yet (RNF08).
+- [x] `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` (new) -- `Entry` class + `EntrySource` enum -- mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`.
+- [x] `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` (new) -- abstract `EntriesRepository.create(...)` → `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>>` -- the port later epics extend.
+- [x] `lib/features/entries/data/models/entry_dto.dart` (+ generated `.g.dart`) -- `@JsonSerializable()` mirroring the response `data` object.
+- [x] `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` (new) -- posts to `entries-create` via `ApiClient.post`, decodes `EntryDto`.
+- [x] `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` (new) -- implements `create`; on success writes to the `entries` Hive box keyed by id; maps `EntryDto` → `Entry`.
+- [x] `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` (new) -- registers datasource/repository, opens/registers the `entries` Hive box.
+- [x] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- wire `Hive.initFlutter()` + `registerEntriesFeature()` + `registerCaptureFeature()`.
+- [x] `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- own sealed state (active tab, text, saving/error); calls `EntriesRepository.create` directly on Salvar.
+- [x] `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` (new) -- 3-tab bottom sheet; Texto functional, Áudio/Foto idle placeholders.
+- [x] `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` (new) -- registers `TextEntryCubit`.
+- [x] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- add the always-tappable "+" control to `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` that opens `InsertionModal`.
+- [x] Unit/widget tests under `test/features/entries/`, `test/features/capture/` covering the I/O matrix above.
+
+**Acceptance Criteria:**
+- Given `features/entries/` doesn't exist yet, when this story is built, then `entries/domain` owns `Entry` + `EntriesRepository(create)` + the entries Hive box, and `features/capture/` never imports `entries/data` or `entries/presentation`.
+- Given the "+" control, when tapped, then the Insertion Modal opens with the `sheetUp` entrance (skipped under Reduce Motion).
+- Given any state change this story introduces, when a screen reader is active, then an announced label accompanies it — never color/animation alone.
+- Given `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test`, then both report zero issues / all green.
+
+## Spec Change Log
+
+- 2026-11-04 — Token-count checkpoint (step-02): spec exceeded 1600 tokens (~2676) because it bundled a proactive offline-detection/banner pattern that doesn't exist anywhere in the app yet. Human chose [S] Split: carved the connectivity/banner work out to `deferred-work.md` and narrowed this story's "+" control to always-tappable, with offline failures surfacing through the existing reactive `Failure.networkOffline` path. KEEP: the `entries`/`capture` feature stand-up, Hive write-through, and modal-shell scope are otherwise unchanged from the original investigation.
+
+## Design Notes
+
+- **Hive storage shape:** entries are cached as raw `Map<String, dynamic>` (via `EntryDto.toJson()`), not a generated `HiveObject`/`TypeAdapter` — avoids adapter codegen for a box nothing reads yet (reads start in Epic 4); revisit if a future story needs typed queries.
+- **No use-case layer:** `TextEntryCubit` calls `EntriesRepository.create` directly, matching this codebase's existing convention (`AccountSettingsCubit`, `AuthCubit`) — RF10's reuse requirement is satisfied by the port itself, not an extra use-case class.
+- **"+" is minimal:** a single tappable control, not the RF04 composer bar — avoids building chat-input UI that RF04 will define and may not match.
+
+## Verification
+
+**Commands:**
+- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves with no conflicts.
+- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates `entry_dto.g.dart` with no errors.
+- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
+- `fvm flutter test` -- all green, including new tests under `test/features/entries/`, `test/features/capture/`.

+import 'presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart';
+
+/// Registers the `capture` feature into the project's single `get_it`
+/// instance (`sl`). Unlike every other feature's cubit in this codebase
+/// (`AccountSettingsCubit`/`AuthCubit`, lazy singletons), [TextEntryCubit]
+/// is a **factory** — the Insertion Modal needs a fresh instance per "+"
+/// tap (Boundaries: "Modal open resets"), not one long-lived instance
+/// reused across opens. Called from `setupCoreDependencies()` right after
+/// `registerEntriesFeature()` (Code Map).
+void registerCaptureFeature() {
+  sl.registerFactory<TextEntryCubit>(
+    () => TextEntryCubit(sl<EntriesRepository>()),
+  );
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
+
+import '../../../entries/domain/entities/entry.dart';
+import '../../../entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart';
+
+/// The Insertion Modal's 3 tabs — Boundaries: "3 equal-width tabs (Texto/
+/// Áudio/Foto)". Only [texto] is functional this story; [audio]/[foto]
+/// render idle, non-interactive placeholders (Stories 3.2/3.3).
+enum CaptureTab { texto, audio, foto }
+
+/// Capture's own state for the Insertion Modal — never the shared
+/// `Resource<T>` (Boundaries). A sealed class, not `freezed` (no codegen
+/// for this story beyond `entry_dto.g.dart`, Verification): every
+/// variant always carries the common [activeTab]/[text] so switching tabs
+/// or typing never needs to know which variant it's coming from.
+sealed class TextEntryState {
+  const TextEntryState({required this.activeTab, required this.text});
+
+  final CaptureTab activeTab;
+  final String text;
+}
+
+/// Ready to type/save — the state immediately after the modal opens
+/// (Boundaries: "Opens on Texto, all 3 tabs idle/empty"), after a tab
+/// switch, and after a keystroke.
+class TextEntryIdle extends TextEntryState {
+  const TextEntryIdle({required super.activeTab, required super.text});
+}
+
+/// Salvar tapped, `POST /entries` in flight — the I/O matrix's "no
+/// auto-retry, no double-submit": `InsertionModal` disables Salvar/the
+/// text field for the duration of this state.
+class TextEntrySaving extends TextEntryState {
+  const TextEntrySaving({required super.activeTab, required super.text});
+}
+
+/// The save attempt succeeded — `InsertionModal`'s listener reacts to
+/// this by popping the sheet (I/O matrix: "success closes the modal").
+/// Terminal: nothing meaningful follows it for this cubit instance, since
+/// the modal (and the factory-scoped cubit backing it) is already
+/// closing.
+class TextEntrySaved extends TextEntryState {
+  const TextEntrySaved({required super.activeTab, required super.text});
+}
+
+/// The last save attempt failed (incl. offline, via the existing
+/// `Failure.networkOffline`) — [message] is `Failure.message` verbatim
+/// (I/O matrix: "Inline message from `Failure.message`"); Salvar is
+/// re-enabled, the modal stays open, no auto-retry.
+class TextEntryError extends TextEntryState {
+  const TextEntryError({
+    required super.activeTab,
+    required super.text,
+    required this.message,
+  });
+
+  final String message;
+}
+
+/// Drives `InsertionModal`. Calls [EntriesRepository.create] directly on
+/// [save] — no use-case layer, matching this codebase's existing
+/// convention (Design Notes: `AccountSettingsCubit`/`AuthCubit`). A fresh,
+/// `get_it`-factory-scoped instance per "+" tap (Boundaries: "Modal open
+/// resets") — starting state is always [TextEntryIdle] on
+/// [CaptureTab.texto] with empty text, so no explicit reset method is
+/// needed the way `AccountSettingsCubit.clearStaleError()` needs one for
+/// its own long-lived singleton.
+class TextEntryCubit extends Cubit<TextEntryState> {
+  TextEntryCubit(this._repository)
+    : super(const TextEntryIdle(activeTab: CaptureTab.texto, text: ''));
+
+  final EntriesRepository _repository;
+
+  /// Switches the active tab, preserving whatever Texto text was already
+  /// typed (Never: the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule is Story 3.4's
+  /// scope — this story's trivial case just needs the tab itself to
+  /// switch without losing in-progress text or firing any `create` call).
+  /// Dropped while [TextEntrySaving]/[TextEntryError] is only cosmetic —
+  /// a save already in flight for the Texto tab is untouched by this,
+  /// since `save()` captures its own `activeTab`/`text` at call time.
+  void selectTab(CaptureTab tab) {
+    if (tab == state.activeTab) {
+      return;
+    }
+    emit(TextEntryIdle(activeTab: tab, text: state.text));
+  }
+
+  /// Mirrors the Texto field's own `TextEditingController` into this
+  /// cubit's state, so [save] has the latest typed text to send. Ignored
+  /// while a save is already in flight — the field is disabled in that
+  /// state (`InsertionModal`), so this should never fire then regardless.
+  void updateText(String text) {
+    if (state is TextEntrySaving) {
+      return;
+    }
+    emit(TextEntryIdle(activeTab: state.activeTab, text: text));
+  }
+
+  /// I/O matrix's "Happy path save"/"Save fails" rows: fires `POST
+  /// /entries` with `source: manual` (Boundaries — the only source this
+  /// story ever sends) for whatever non-empty text is currently typed. A
+  /// blank/whitespace-only text never calls [EntriesRepository.create] —
+  /// `InsertionModal` already disables Salvar for that case, but this is
+  /// the authoritative guard regardless of how `save()` is invoked.
+  Future<void> save() async {
+    final text = state.text.trim();
+    if (text.isEmpty || state is TextEntrySaving) {
+      return;
+    }
+    final activeTab = state.activeTab;
+    emit(TextEntrySaving(activeTab: activeTab, text: text));
+    final result = await _repository.create(
+      content: text,
+      source: EntrySource.manual,
+    );
+    // Mirrors `AccountSettingsCubit.toggleBiometric`'s own guard: this
+    // cubit's `dispose:`/`close()` can race the awaited call above (e.g.
+    // the modal's barrier is dismissed mid-save) — `emit()` after `close()`
+    // would otherwise throw.
+    if (isClosed) {
+      return;
+    }
+    result.match(
+      (failure) => emit(
+        TextEntryError(activeTab: activeTab, text: text, message: failure.message),
+      ),
+      (_) => emit(TextEntrySaved(activeTab: activeTab, text: text)),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'dart:async';
+
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/semantics.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
+
+import '../../../../core/design_tokens.dart';
+import '../../../../core/widgets/app_button.dart';
+import '../cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart';
+
+/// The Insertion Modal — a 3-tab bottom sheet (Texto/Áudio/Foto) opened
+/// from the Home/Chat "+" control (`placeholder_screens.dart`). Only
+/// Texto is functional this story (Boundaries) — Áudio/Foto each render
+/// their own idle, non-interactive placeholder (Stories 3.2/3.3).
+class InsertionModal extends StatelessWidget {
+  const InsertionModal({required this.cubit, super.key});
+
+  final TextEntryCubit cubit;
+
+  /// Presents the modal exactly as the Boundaries dictate:
+  /// `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor:
+  /// colorScrimHeavy)`, `radiusLg` top corners + `elevation2` (drawn by
+  /// this widget's own `Container`, not Material's `elevation` double —
+  /// same convention `ConfirmationDialog`'s card already uses), and a
+  /// `durationSheetUp` entrance that collapses to zero under Reduce
+  /// Motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations`).
+  ///
+  /// [cubit] is a fresh, `get_it`-factory-scoped instance — one per "+"
+  /// tap (Boundaries: "Modal open resets"), closed here once the sheet is
+  /// gone, regardless of how it closed (Salvar success, "x", swipe-down,
+  /// or barrier dismiss) — the caller never has to remember to do this
+  /// itself.
+  static Future<void> show(
+    BuildContext context, {
+    required TextEntryCubit cubit,
+  }) async {
+    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
+    final controller =
+        BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
+          ..duration = reduceMotion
+              ? Duration.zero
+              : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
+          // Boundaries only names the entrance, but Reduce Motion should
+          // collapse the exit the same way — otherwise dismissing the
+          // sheet would still animate for anyone who asked for no motion.
+          ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
+    try {
+      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
+        context: context,
+        isScrollControlled: true,
+        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
+        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
+        elevation: 0,
+        transitionAnimationController: controller,
+        builder: (_) => InsertionModal(cubit: cubit),
+      );
+    } finally {
+      // `showModalBottomSheet`'s own Future completes as soon as the
+      // route is popped — *before* the exit (`reverse()`) animation the
+      // framework drives on this same controller actually finishes.
+      // Disposing immediately would cancel that animation's ticker
+      // mid-flight, permanently freezing the sheet on screen (its
+      // `AnimatedBuilder` keeps rendering the controller's last value,
+      // and the route itself never reaches `AnimationStatus.dismissed`
+      // to be removed from the `Overlay`). Documented behavior
+      // (`BottomSheet.transitionAnimationController`'s own doc: "the
+      // caller is responsible for disposing it when the controller is
+      // no longer needed") — waiting for `dismissed` first is that
+      // "no longer needed" point.
+      if (!controller.isDismissed) {
+        final animationDone = Completer<void>();
+        void onStatusChange(AnimationStatus status) {
+          if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
+            animationDone.complete();
+          }
+        }
+
+        controller.addStatusListener(onStatusChange);
+        await animationDone.future;
+        controller.removeStatusListener(onStatusChange);
+      }
+      controller.dispose();
+      await cubit.close();
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return BlocProvider.value(value: cubit, child: const _InsertionModalBody());
+  }
+}
+
+class _InsertionModalBody extends StatefulWidget {
+  const _InsertionModalBody();
+
+  @override
+  State<_InsertionModalBody> createState() => _InsertionModalBodyState();
+}
+
+class _InsertionModalBodyState extends State<_InsertionModalBody> {
+  final _textController = TextEditingController();
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    _textController.dispose();
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  // Mirrors `account_settings_screen.dart`'s own `_announce` — VoiceOver
+  // (this app is iOS-only) doesn't reliably treat a live-region subtree
+  // update as an announcement on its own, so every state change this
+  // story introduces is spoken explicitly here instead (Acceptance
+  // Criteria: "no color/animation alone").
+  Future<void> _announce(String message) async {
+    if (!mounted) {
+      return;
+    }
+    await SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement(
+      View.of(context),
+      message,
+      TextDirection.ltr,
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return BlocConsumer<TextEntryCubit, TextEntryState>(
+      listener: (context, state) {
+        switch (state) {
+          case TextEntrySaved():
+            // I/O matrix: "success closes the modal".
+            Navigator.of(context).pop();
+          case TextEntrySaving():
+            _announce('Salvando registro');
+          case TextEntryError():
+            _announce(state.message);
+          case TextEntryIdle():
+            break;
+        }
+      },
+      builder: (context, state) {
+        return Container(
+          padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
+          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
+            color: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
+              top: Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusLg),
+            ),
+            boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation2,
+          ),
+          child: Padding(
+            // Keeps the Texto field clear of the on-screen keyboard — the
+            // sheet is `isScrollControlled: true`, so it already grows to
+            // fit; this is the standard companion fix for the keyboard
+            // inset itself.
+            padding: EdgeInsets.only(
+              bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom,
+            ),
+            child: SafeArea(
+              top: false,
+              child: Column(
+                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+                children: [
+                  Row(
+                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
+                    children: [
+                      Expanded(child: _TabBar(activeTab: state.activeTab)),
+                      const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
+                      const _CloseButton(),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                  const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
+                  switch (state.activeTab) {
+                    CaptureTab.texto => _TextoTab(
+                      controller: _textController,
+                      state: state,
+                    ),
+                    CaptureTab.audio => const _IdleTabPlaceholder(
+                      icon: Icons.mic_none,
+                      label: 'Áudio chega em breve',
+                    ),
+                    CaptureTab.foto => const _IdleTabPlaceholder(
+                      icon: Icons.photo_camera_outlined,
+                      label: 'Foto chega em breve',
+                    ),
+                  },
+                ],
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+      },
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _TabBar extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _TabBar({required this.activeTab});
+
+  final CaptureTab activeTab;
+
+  static const _tabs = [
+    (CaptureTab.texto, 'Texto'),
+    (CaptureTab.audio, 'Áudio'),
+    (CaptureTab.foto, 'Foto'),

+  @override

+}
+

+  const _TabButton({

+  });

+  final CaptureTab tab;

+  @override

+            child: Text(
+              label,

+                color: isActive

+}
+
+class _CloseButton extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _CloseButton();
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Semantics(
+      button: true,
+      label: 'Fechar',
+      child: InkWell(
+        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
+          Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusFull),
+        ),
+        // I/O matrix: "Cancel before save" — closes/resets, never calls
+        // `create` (this handler never touches the cubit at all).
+        onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),

+}
+

+

+import 'package:fpdart/fpdart.dart';
+
+import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
+import '../../../../core/network/api_client.dart';
+import '../../domain/entities/entry.dart';
+import '../models/entry_dto.dart';
+
+/// The entries feature's one write call so far (`entries-create`) — posts
+/// via the shared `ApiClient`, mirroring `account_remote_data_source.dart`'s
+/// pattern.
+class EntriesRemoteDataSource {
+  EntriesRemoteDataSource(this._apiClient);
+
+  final ApiClient _apiClient;
+
+  /// Sends exactly `{content, source}` — this story never passes
+  /// `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt`/`mediaDurationSeconds` (Boundaries: no
+  /// `Entry` field beyond the modeled 8; those three are optional in the
+  /// contract and belong to later stories/epics).
+  Future<Either<Failure, EntryDto>> create({
+    required String content,
+    required EntrySource source,
+  }) async {
+    final result = await _apiClient.post(
+      'entries-create',
+      data: {'content': content, 'source': source.name},
+    );
+    return result.flatMap((json) {
+      try {
+        final data = json['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
+        return right(EntryDto.fromJson(data));
+      } catch (error) {
+        // A 200 response that doesn't match the expected shape is a
+        // client-side parse failure, never a backend-sent code — maps to
+        // the local-only `malformedResponse` (RNF09: no exception escapes
+        // unmapped).
+        return left(Failure.malformedResponse(message: error.toString()));
+      }
+    });
+  }
+}

+/// `POST /entries`'s response `data` object (`openapi.yaml:370-456`) —
+/// decodes exactly the 8 fields [Entry] models (Code Map/Boundaries);
+/// every other field (`tags`/`piiStatus`/`piiSpans`/`embeddingStatus`/
+/// `mediaDurationSeconds`) is simply ignored by `json_serializable`'s
+/// generated `fromJson`, same convention `AccountSettingsDto` already
+/// uses for the fields it doesn't model.

+/// [source] serializes/deserializes against [EntrySource]'s own `.name`

+/// names already match the backend's lowercase `manual`/`audio`/`photo`/

+    required this.content,
+    required this.source,
+    required this.chatMessageId,
+    required this.occurredAt,

+    required this.createdAt,

+  final String occurredAt;
+  final int serverRevision;
+  final String createdAt;
+  final String updatedAt;

+// The constructor keeps public named params (`remoteDataSource`,
+// `entriesBox`) distinct from the private fields they initialize, matching
+// `account_settings_repository_impl.dart`'s documented convention.
+// ignore_for_file: prefer_initializing_formals
+import 'package:fpdart/fpdart.dart';
+import 'package:hive_ce/hive_ce.dart';
+
+import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
+import '../../domain/entities/entry.dart';
+import '../../domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart';
+import '../datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart';
+import '../models/entry_dto.dart';
+
+/// On success, writes the entry through to the `entries` Hive box (`Box
+/// <Map>`, keyed by id, raw `EntryDto.toJson()` — Design Notes) *before*
+/// returning `right(...)`, same "persist then return" ordering
+/// `AuthRepositoryImpl._authenticate` already uses for its own
+/// post-success side effect.
+class EntriesRepositoryImpl implements EntriesRepository {
+  EntriesRepositoryImpl({
+    required EntriesRemoteDataSource remoteDataSource,
+    required Box<Map> entriesBox,
+  }) : _remoteDataSource = remoteDataSource,
+       _entriesBox = entriesBox;
+
+  final EntriesRemoteDataSource _remoteDataSource;
+  final Box<Map> _entriesBox;
+
+  @override
+  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({
+    required String content,
+    required EntrySource source,
+  }) async {
+    final result = await _remoteDataSource.create(
+      content: content,
+      source: source,
+    );
+    return result.match((failure) async => left(failure), (dto) async {
+      // A thrown Hive/disk exception must never escape unmapped (RNF09) —
+      // same rationale/fallback `AuthRepositoryImpl` already uses for its
+      // own local-persistence step.
+      try {
+        await _entriesBox.put(dto.id, dto.toJson());
+      } catch (error) {
+        return left(Failure.malformedResponse(message: error.toString()));
+      }
+      return right(_toEntry(dto));
+    });
+  }
+
+  Entry _toEntry(EntryDto dto) => Entry(
+    id: dto.id,
+    content: dto.content,
+    source: dto.source,
+    chatMessageId: dto.chatMessageId,
+    occurredAt: dto.occurredAt,
+    serverRevision: dto.serverRevision,
+    createdAt: dto.createdAt,
+    updatedAt: dto.updatedAt,
+  );
+}

+/// `POST /entries`'s four possible origins (`openapi.yaml:345-351`). This
+/// story only ever produces [manual] (Boundaries: "source=manual for this
+/// story") — the other three exist here already so the port
+/// ([EntriesRepository.create]) doesn't need to change shape when Stories
+/// 3.2/3.3 (audio/photo) and RF10 (chat) start passing them.
+enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }
+
+/// A saved journal entry — plain `{id, content, source, chatMessageId,
+/// occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt}` class, no `freezed`
+/// (mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`: this feature has no need for the
+/// union/copyWith machinery `Failure` uses). Boundaries: never a field
+/// beyond this exact set — `tags`/`piiStatus`/`piiSpans`/`embeddingStatus`/
+/// `mediaDurationSeconds` belong to later epics, not this story.
+///
+/// [occurredAt]/[createdAt]/[updatedAt] are kept as the backend's own ISO
+/// 8601 strings rather than parsed into `DateTime` — nothing in this story
+/// reads or formats them (Design Notes: the Hive box nothing reads from
+/// yet), so parsing would add risk (a malformed string throwing) with no
+/// behavior to justify it.
+class Entry {
+  const Entry({
+    required this.id,
+    required this.content,
+    required this.source,
+    required this.chatMessageId,
+    required this.occurredAt,
+    required this.serverRevision,
+    required this.createdAt,
+    required this.updatedAt,
+  });
+
+  final String id;
+  final String content;
+  final EntrySource source;
+
+  /// Non-null only for a [EntrySource.chat]-sourced entry (RF10) — always
+  /// `null` for this story's [EntrySource.manual] entries.
+  final String? chatMessageId;
+  final String occurredAt;
+  final int serverRevision;
+  final String createdAt;
+  final String updatedAt;
+
+  @override
+  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
+      identical(this, other) ||
+      (other is Entry &&
+          other.id == id &&
+          other.content == content &&
+          other.source == source &&
+          other.chatMessageId == chatMessageId &&
+          other.occurredAt == occurredAt &&
+          other.serverRevision == serverRevision &&
+          other.createdAt == createdAt &&
+          other.updatedAt == updatedAt);
+
+  @override
+  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
+    id,
+    content,
+    source,
+    chatMessageId,
+    occurredAt,
+    serverRevision,
+    createdAt,
+    updatedAt,
+  );
+
+  @override
+  String toString() =>
+      'Entry(id: $id, content: $content, source: $source, '
+      'chatMessageId: $chatMessageId, occurredAt: $occurredAt, '
+      'serverRevision: $serverRevision, createdAt: $createdAt, '
+      'updatedAt: $updatedAt)';
+}

+/// (Code Map). A raw `Box<Map>`, not a generated `HiveObject`/
+/// `TypeAdapter` (Design Notes: avoids adapter codegen for a box nothing
+/// reads yet).
+const entriesBoxName = 'entries';
+
+/// Registers the `entries` feature into the project's single `get_it`
+/// instance (`sl`) — mirrors `features/account/account_injection.dart`'s
+/// pattern. Called from `setupCoreDependencies()` right after
+/// `Hive.initFlutter()` (Code Map), which must already have run by the
+/// time this opens its box.
+Future<void> registerEntriesFeature() async {
+  final entriesBox = await Hive.openBox<Map>(entriesBoxName);

+  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesRemoteDataSource>(
+    () => EntriesRemoteDataSource(sl<ApiClient>()),
+  );

+  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesRepository>(
+    () => EntriesRepositoryImpl(
+      remoteDataSource: sl<EntriesRemoteDataSource>(),
+      entriesBox: sl<Box<Map>>(),
+    ),
+  );
+}

  Review of the Story 3.1 diff (`/private/tmp/.../scratchpad/story-3-1-diff.txt`), cross-checked against the live repo (`fvm flutter analyze` → 0 issues, `fvm flutter test` → 394/394 passed, so both are clean; findings below are about correctness/completeness, not the gates).
  
  - The story's own acceptance criteria in `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md:525-528` (backed by `UX-DR30`/`AD-9`, epics.md:179) state the "+" entry point must be *disabled* with an offline banner when the device is offline, "the same offline-banner treatment as chat send." The implementation (`lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` FAB) leaves "+" always tappable and pushes this to `deferred-work.md`. The deferral's own rationale ("chat send isn't built yet either, no existing pattern to reuse") doesn't actually address the AC — UX-DR30/AD-9 already fully specify the required behavior independent of chat send's existence, so this story could have been the one to introduce the shared connectivity pattern instead of being blocked on a sibling story. This is a real, unmet AC, not just a documented nice-to-have.
  - Prototype copy mismatch: `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.3 specifies the Texto tab's placeholder as `"Escreva livremente..."`; `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`'s `_TextoTab` uses `hintText: 'Escreva seu registro...'` — a literal deviation from the frozen visual reference text.
  - `_InsertionModalBodyState._announce`'s own doc comment claims "every state change this story introduces is spoken explicitly here," but the `BlocConsumer` listener's switch (`insertion_modal.dart`, listener block) only announces `TextEntrySaving`/`TextEntryError`. `TextEntrySaved` (save success) and tab switches (which re-emit `TextEntryIdle`) fall to `break;` with no explicit announcement — contradicting both the comment and the Acceptance Criteria's "an announced label accompanies [every state change] — never color/animation alone."
  - The tab bar (`_TabButton.onTap` → `TextEntryCubit.selectTab`) is never disabled while `TextEntrySaving` is in flight. A user who taps Áudio/Foto mid-save silently overwrites the saving UI with `TextEntryIdle`; when the original `save()`'s awaited `_repository.create()` later resolves, it still emits `TextEntrySaved`/`TextEntryError` keyed to the stale `activeTab`/`text` captured at call time — e.g. a late `TextEntrySaved` pops the whole modal out from under a user who has since moved to Foto, or a late `TextEntryError` yanks them back to Texto. No test exercises this interleaving.
  - No test asserts that closing/cancelling the modal while a save is in flight still results in the entry actually being persisted. `text_entry_cubit_test.dart`'s "emit() after close() never throws" only checks that `emit()` doesn't throw post-close; it never verifies the Hive write happened (which it should, since `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create` persists before the cubit's `isClosed` check even runs) — a real behavior with zero direct coverage.
  - The `entries` Hive box (`lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart`) is opened with no `encryptionCipher`, so raw journal text now lands in plaintext on disk. That sits oddly next to RF03's whole premise — a biometric/PIN "access barrier … before exposing the user's data" — since anyone who can read the device filesystem/an unencrypted backup bypasses that barrier entirely for entry content. Tokens already get `flutter_secure_storage`; no equivalent was considered for entries.
  - The box is a single global, unnamespaced by user (`entriesBoxName = 'entries'`), with no clearing hook on logout/account switch. Not exploitable today (no logout feature exists yet), but Epic 4 starts reading from this same box, so this needs a decision before then, not after — otherwise a second account on a shared device inherits the first account's cached entries.
  - `sl.registerSingleton<Box<Map>>(entriesBox)` registers by bare generic type with no `instanceName`. Since AD-15 (epics.md:128) mandates every `hive_ce` box store a raw server-shaped map — i.e. `Box<Map>` is the expected shape for every future feature's box too — this registration will collide with (or force awkward workarounds for) the next feature that also opens a `Box<Map>`.
  - Stale scaffold placeholders left behind: `lib/features/entries/data/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/entries/domain/.gitkeep`, and `lib/features/capture/presentation/.gitkeep` are now redundant since those directories contain populated subdirectories (`data/datasources/`, `data/models/`, `data/repositories/`, `domain/entities/`, `domain/repositories/`, `presentation/cubit/`, `presentation/widgets/`) — the diff adds the real files but never removes the now-unnecessary `.gitkeep`s.
  - The FAB's placement diverges from the prototype's actual "+" affordance. `prototype-extract.md` §2.2 describes "+" as embedded in the Home/Chat composer bar, not a floating action button. The spec's Design Notes consciously substitute a bare `FloatingActionButton` to avoid prematurely building RF04's composer — a defensible call — but nothing flags this visual divergence for revisit when RF04 lands (unlike the offline-banner gap, which is at least tracked in `deferred-work.md`).
  - `TextEntryCubit.save()` stores `state.text.trim()` into the emitted `TextEntrySaving`/`TextEntryError` states, while the on-screen `TextEditingController` keeps the original, untrimmed text. If the user had leading/trailing whitespace, the cubit's "current text" (what a retry would resend) and the field's visible text momentarily disagree after a failed save — currently masked because the next keystroke resyncs them, but a latent inconsistency.
  - `test/support/fake_path_provider_platform.dart`'s `getApplicationDocumentsPath()` creates a brand-new temp directory (`Directory.systemTemp.createTempSync(...)`) on every call and never deletes it. Since `setupCoreDependencies()` now always calls `Hive.initFlutter()`, every test run that exercises DI bootstrap (which is most of them, directly or via `main_test.dart`/`bootstrap_integration_test.dart`) leaks an orphaned temp folder on the dev machine/CI runner.

</agent-message>

Tokens already get `flutter_secure_storage`; no equivalent was considered for entries.

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

Code review of your Story 3.1 diff is done (three parallel reviewers: blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap). Nine findings were classified as "patch" — real, trivially fixable, no spec change needed. Apply all nine, then re-run the spec's Verification commands (`fvm flutter analyze`, `fvm flutter test`) and confirm they still pass.

1. **Race: tab switch / close during in-flight save.** `_TabButton.onTap` (calls `TextEntryCubit.selectTab`) and `_CloseButton.onTap` in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` are never disabled while `state is TextEntrySaving`. A user can switch to Áudio/Foto or tap "x" mid-save; when the stale `save()` call later resolves, it emits `TextEntrySaved`/`TextEntryError` keyed to the tab/text captured at call time, which can pop the modal unexpectedly or show an error against a tab the user has since left. Fix: disable the tab bar's `InkWell.onTap` and the close button's `onTap` while `TextEntrySaving` (same pattern already used for the Texto `TextField`'s `enabled: !isSaving`).

2. **Cubit-level guard for the same race.** `TextEntryCubit.selectTab` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart`) should also no-op when `state is TextEntrySaving`, as defense in depth alongside fix #1's UI-level disable.

3. **Missing announcements.** `_InsertionModalBodyState._announce`'s doc comment claims "every state change this story introduces is spoken explicitly here," but the listener's switch in `insertion_modal.dart` only announces `TextEntrySaving`/`TextEntryError` — `TextEntrySaved` (save success) and tab switches (which re-emit `TextEntryIdle`) fall to `break;` with no announcement. This contradicts the story's own Acceptance Criteria ("any state change... an announced label accompanies it — never color/animation alone"). Fix: add an announcement for `TextEntrySaved` (e.g. "Registro salvo") and for a tab switch (e.g. announce the newly active tab's label), and correct the doc comment to match actual coverage.

4. **No test verifies any announcement actually fires.** `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_test.dart` never asserts on `SemanticsService`/the accessibility channel — only on visible `Text`/`TextField`/button state. This codebase already has a working pattern for this: `interceptAnnouncements()` in `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` (intercepts the `flutter/accessibility` platform channel to capture real announcement strings). Reuse that pattern (extract to a shared test helper if convenient) and add assertions for the Saving/Error/Saved/tab-switch announcements from fix #3.

5. **Hive write-through only tested against an always-succeeding mock.** `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart` uses `class MockBox extends Mock implements Box<Map> {}` with `when(() => mockBox.put(any(), any())).thenAnswer((_) async {})` — this never exercises real `hive_ce` encoding of the actual `EntryDto.toJson()` shape (enum, nullable field, ints, ISO date strings). Add an integration-style test under `test/features/entries/` that opens a real temp-dir-backed box (same `FakePathProviderPlatform`/`Hive.initFlutter()` setup already used in `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart`), constructs `EntriesRepositoryImpl` with a fake `EntriesRemoteDataSource` returning `Right(EntryDto)`, calls `create()`, then asserts `box.get(id)` round-trips the expected map.

6. **Prototype copy mismatch.** `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`'s `_TextoTab` uses `hintText: 'Escreva seu registro...'`. The frozen prototype reference (`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:77`) specifies the Texto tab's placeholder as exactly `"Escreva livremente..."`. Fix the literal string to match — verified directly against that line, this is not ambiguous.

7. **No client-side length bound on the Texto field.** The backend's `POST /entries` `content` field is capped at `maxLength: 20000` (`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`). The `TextField` in `_TextoTab` has no `maxLength`, so a user can type past the backend's limit and get an avoidable round-trip failure. Add `maxLength: 20000` to that `TextField` to mirror the documented backend limit exactly (don't invent a different number).

8. **Redundant `.gitkeep` files.** `lib/features/entries/data/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/entries/domain/.gitkeep`, and `lib/features/capture/presentation/.gitkeep` are now redundant — their directories contain populated subdirectories with real files (`data/datasources/`, `data/models/`, `data/repositories/`, `presentation/cubit/`, `presentation/widgets/`). Delete these three `.gitkeep` files.

input.new_string:
**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves with no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates `entry_dto.g.dart` with no errors.
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- all green, including new tests under `test/features/entries/`, `test/features/capture/`.

## Suggested Review Order

**Entries domain & port**

- The one-method port every later epic (Search, Timeline, RF10) extends — its shape is this story's main architectural bet.
  [`entries_repository.dart:17`](../../lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart#L17)

- Plain entity, 8 fields only, no `freezed` (mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`) — deliberately not speculative beyond what the API returns.
  [`entry.dart:20`](../../lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart#L20)

- The 4-value `source` enum the port and DTO both key off of.
  [`entry.dart:6`](../../lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart#L6)

**Entries data layer**

- `create()` posts to `entries-create`, decodes `EntryDto`, maps parse failures to `malformedResponse`.
  [`entries_remote_data_source.dart:20`](../../lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart#L20)

- Write-through cache: persists to the `entries` Hive box *before* returning `Right` — the ordering that matters.
  [`entries_repository_impl.dart:43`](../../lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart#L43)

- `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create` — full success/failure mapping, including the Hive-write-failure branch.
  [`entries_repository_impl.dart:30`](../../lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart#L30)

- `@JsonSerializable` DTO — the wire/cache shape; enum round-trips via `.name`.
  [`entry_dto.dart:19`](../../lib/features/entries/data/models/entry_dto.dart#L19)

- First `hive_ce` box in the app — raw `Box<Map>`, opened before DI registers on top of it.
  [`entries_injection.dart:21`](../../lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart#L21)

**Capture state machine**

- Sealed state (Idle/Saving/Saved/Error) — deliberately not the shared `Resource<T>`.
  [`text_entry_cubit.dart:16`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart#L16)

- `save()` — fires `create`, maps the result, guards against emitting after `close()`.
  [`text_entry_cubit.dart:110`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart#L110)

- `selectTab` — review-added guard: no-ops while a save is in flight (race fix).
  [`text_entry_cubit.dart:86`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart#L86)

**Insertion Modal UI**

- `show()` — the custom `transitionAnimationController` lifecycle; read the comments, this is the trickiest code in the diff.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:33`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L33)

- `_announce` and its listener switch — the accessibility contract this story's AC requires.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:138`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L138)

- Tab bar disabled while saving — review-added fix for the stale-completion race.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:312`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L312)

- Close button disabled while saving — same race fix, UI side.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:356`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L356)

- Texto tab: frozen prototype copy + backend's `maxLength` mirrored exactly (both review-added).
  [`insertion_modal.dart:420`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L420)

**Wiring**

- `Hive.initFlutter()` ahead of `registerEntriesFeature()`/`registerCaptureFeature()` — ordering is load-bearing here.
  [`injection_container.dart:90`](../../lib/core/di/injection_container.dart#L90)

- `TextEntryCubit` registered as a **factory**, not a singleton — a fresh instance per "+" tap.
  [`capture_injection.dart:13`](../../lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart#L13)

- The "+" entry point — deliberately a bare FAB, not RF04's composer (see Design Notes).
  [`placeholder_screens.dart:94`](../../lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart#L94)

- First `Duration`/motion token this file defines.
  [`design_tokens.dart:236`](../../lib/core/design_tokens.dart#L236)

**Tests**

- Real-box round-trip (review-added) — the only test that exercises actual `hive_ce` encoding, not a mock.
  [`entries_repository_impl_integration_test.dart`](../../test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_integration_test.dart#L1)

- Announcement assertions (review-added) via the newly-extracted shared helper.
  [`intercept_announcements.dart`](../../test/support/intercept_announcements.dart#L1)

- Full I/O-matrix coverage for the modal (happy path, offline/failure, cancel, Reduce Motion, saving-disables-controls).
  [`insertion_modal_test.dart`](../../test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_test.dart#L1)

- Cubit unit tests, including the save/selectTab race guard.
  [`text_entry_cubit_test.dart`](../../test/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit_test.dart#L1)

- Mocked-datasource repository tests, DI resolution smoke test, and the FAB/bootstrap wiring checks.
  [`entries_repository_impl_test.dart`](../../test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart#L1)

content.text:
## Story 3.1 complete: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell

**Commit:** `8e92fd7` — 32 files, +2391/−30

**What shipped:**
- `features/entries/` stood up from scratch: `Entry` entity, `EntriesRepository.create` port, the app's first `hive_ce` box, with a write-through cache on every successful save
- `features/capture/` stood up: `TextEntryCubit` (own sealed state, not the shared `Resource<T>`) + the Insertion Modal — 3-tab bottom sheet, Texto fully functional, Áudio/Foto idle placeholders
- A minimal "+" entry point added to the Home/Chat placeholder screen
- One new design token (`durationSheetUp`)

**Scope management:** the spec initially ran to ~2,676 tokens (over the 900–1600 target) because it bundled a proactive offline-detection/banner pattern that doesn't exist anywhere in the app yet — you chose to split that out, so it's logged in [deferred-work.md](_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md) rather than built speculatively.

**Code review** (3 parallel reviewers — blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap) found 9 real, trivially-fixable issues, all patched and verified: a tab-switch/close race during in-flight saves, missing screen-reader announcements for save-success and tab changes (plus tests for them, reusing an existing `interceptAnnouncements` pattern), a Hive write-through test that only exercised a mock, a prototype-copy mismatch, a missing client-side length cap, stale `.gitkeep` files, and a test-infra temp-dir leak. 5 more real-but-non-blocking findings (plaintext storage at rest, DI box-registration collision risk, no per-user namespacing, FAB/prototype visual divergence, swipe-dismiss mid-save) are logged to `deferred-work.md` for later.

**Final state:** `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues. `fvm flutter test` — 402/402 passing.
